places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Bustling cow town where July mails his letter home and receives Peach's news that Elmira has left; he rides off without searching the saloons for Jake.

places.name: River where July and Joe saw buffalo
places.note: July and Joe chase a small band of eight buffalo and watch them cross a small river.
places.location_hint: in increasingly open country in north Texas, south of the Red River, a day's ride or less before Fort Worth

places.name: July's camp east of Fort Worth
places.note: Heading back east to find Roscoe, they camp on the silent plains; July lies awake longing for Elmira.
places.location_hint: about a half-evening's ride east of Fort Worth, back along the way they came

places.name: Red River
places.note: July's letter reports they have crossed it into Texas.

places.name: Texas
places.note: July and Joe are now in Texas; July wonders if Jake will skip going on to south Texas.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Home they left; Peach writes that Elmira departed soon after, and Roscoe has set out to bring word.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: The postal clerk guesses July is from there by his letter's address.

places.name: Little Rock
places.note: July's brother Ben found Peach there and lived there two months courting her.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Elmira told July her first man Dee Boot died of smallpox there; Joe doubts he is dead.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: July imagines Elmira might have gone toward it, just a few stars north.

groups.label: July Johnson and Joe
groups.at: July's camp east of Fort Worth
groups.hint: camped on the plains a couple of hours' ride east of Fort Worth, turning back to look for Roscoe and Elmira
